verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a hosted identity platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no first-party way to export all WorkOS data (users, organizations, SSO connections) in open formats for leaving. The migration docs cover importing into WorkOS from Auth0, and audit-log export covers only one data type. API/MCP read access is a developer building block rather than an export feature, and the community lock-in question is an open concern rather than evidence either way.
